app.name: Value Wallet
history.title: Earlier versions
withdraw.confirm: Withdraw this? It disappears from the lists; its history stays in your wallet.
erase.confirm: Erase this and all its versions for good? Only an empty mark with the date stays. This cannot be undone.
err.notJson: This file is not a wallet file
err.tooBig: The file is larger than 20 MB
start.lead: Your own record of value: what passed between you and people, organisations or the state, what was promised, what you got and lost, and how much it moved your goals.
start.f1: It stays on this device, encrypted with your passphrase. Nothing is sent anywhere.
start.f2: Your scale, your words. There are no scores of people.
start.f3: If you forget the passphrase, nobody can open the wallet. Keep an exported copy.
unlock.title: Open {name}
unlock.wrong: This passphrase does not open the wallet
create.title: Create a wallet
create.label: Name on this device
create.labelHint: Only you see it. It is stored with the wallet.
create.passHint: At least 4 words or 14 characters. A sentence you will remember works best.
create.ack: I understand: if I forget the passphrase, nobody can open this wallet, and nobody can recover it.
create.ackNeeded: Please confirm that you understand this
create.weak: Too short: use at least 4 words or 14 characters
import.bad: This is not a wallet file of a known version
import.chain: The file has {n} damaged places; everything readable is kept
import.saved: The wallet is now on this device
ex.empty: Nothing yet. Record what you received or gave, even something small.
ex.needOne: Add at least one thing you received or gave
ex.due: Time to compare (you set these dates yourself)
el.label: What
plan.title: What the giver promised
plan.hint: Planned value from {who}. You see it, but it counts in your own figures only as much as you decide (0 by default).
as.title: How was it for me: {ex}
as.lost: What I lost or what it cost me
as.linesHint: You can leave any line empty.
as.goals: Which of my goals it moved
as.noGoals: Add goals on the Goals tab to see how much this moved what matters to you.
as.ownHint: Any number on your own scale.
as.planCountHint: 0 means the promise does not count until you assess it yourself.
as.checkHint: Shown only when you open the wallet. No reminders.
val.none: Link it to a goal to see how much it moved what matters to you.
val.moved: This moved about {k} of the goal "{goal}", which is about {w} of what matters to you now. So it moved about {v} of what matters to you.
val.harm: This set the goal "{goal}" back by about {k}, and that goal is about {w} of what matters to you now. So it cost about {v} of what matters to you.
val.top3: It is one of the three most valuable things of the last 30 days.
val.rank: It is number {n} of {of} things you assessed in the last 30 days.
fc.title: Does this fit how you feel?
fc.lessHint: Lower the contribution or check the goal's numbers
fc.moreHint: Raise the contribution or check the goal's numbers
flag.goal-overfilled: Contributions to "{goal}" already add up to more than it needs, but the goal is still open. Maybe it needs more than you wrote, or it is reached.
flag.scale-disagrees: Your own scores and these shares of what matters order your recent things quite differently. One of them may not match how you feel.
flag.top-goal-untouched: Your most important goal "{goal}" got nothing in 90 days while other goals did. Is it still the most important?
cp.empty: People, organisations and state bodies you exchange with appear here.
cp.name: Name
cp.urlHint: An organisation or a state body may publish what value it plans to give.
cp.badUrl: The address must start with https://
goal.lead: Use any numbers on your own scale. What matters is how important a goal is in your life and how much it needs.
goal.title: Goal
goal.signs: How I will know I reached it
goal.NHint: On the same scale; empty means the same as importance.
goal.needS: Importance must be a positive number
goal.needN: Need must be a positive number
fact.lead: Anything that matters for your goals and how you value things. Facts change; revise them when you see more clearly.
fact.exploringLong: I am still figuring this out
set.planHint: When someone gives you something with a promise, you decide how much of the promise counts before you assess it yourself.
set.storageHint: The wallet is kept on this device, encrypted. Keep an exported copy somewhere safe: another device, a private repository, a backup drive. Backup services come later.
set.readableWarn: This file will not be encrypted. Anyone who gets it can read everything. Continue?
set.passHint: Records stay as they are; only the key that opens them changes.
set.remove: Remove this wallet from this device
set.removeConfirm: Remove the wallet from this device? Without an exported copy it is gone for good.
type.title: Add a type
type.name: Name
foot.locked: Locked. Your data never leaves this device.
foot.unlocked: Open on this device. Locks after 15 minutes without activity.
